page_title: Esen Tunalı Sarı — Founder & Creative Director
meta_description: Discover the personal story of Esen Tunalı Sarı, the software developer and creative director harmonising artificial intelligence with bespoke jewellery design at SILVER & ELEGANT.
heading: The Creative Technologist

sections.label: Heritage
sections.body:
**Every monument begins with an act of structural resilience.**

For Esen, the founder and creative director of SILVER & ELEGANT, the path to modern luxury was forged through adaptation, analytical discipline, and the quiet courage to build something entirely of her own.

Born in Bulgaria, her story is defined by a profound multicultural journey — through Turkey and the Netherlands, before anchoring in the United Kingdom. As a software developer navigating corporate ecosystems, she chose to transcend conventional boundaries—transforming an expansive vision into an independent design practice rooted in permanence.

Her design language draws from the raw geometry of Eastern European brutalist architecture, organic form, and sculptural texture. By harmonising generative design intelligence with bespoke craftsmanship, she engineers jewellery as narrative objects — Future Heirlooms, built to outlast their moment.

sections.label: Modern Studio
sections.body:
The industry took notice swiftly. SILVER & ELEGANT was selected as an official jewellery partner for Paul Costelloe’s opening show at London Fashion Week AW26 — and shortly after, designated as a rising independent design talent globally by the contemporary fashion platform NOT JUST A LABEL, recognised as a defining voice in the future of independent fashion.

Today, operating from her London-based atelier, Esen builds with quiet confidence — piece by piece, structure by structure. A testament that true creative authority is not proclaimed. It is constructed.
